d: Manchester City staged two second-half comebacks to secure a hard-fought 2-2 draw against Napoli in their UEFA Champions League league phase clash. Rasmus Højlund broke the deadlock for Napoli before Ayyoub Bouaddi brought City level midway through the half. Noa Lang restored the visitors' lead with just over 15 minutes remaining, putting Napoli on course for a famous win. However, Rayan Cherki struck late in the 86th minute to ensure the points were shared after an action-packed encounter.
